WHAT WE CAN DELIVER

Practical outputs

Simulation results are meaningful only when the assumptions are clear. We define loads, material properties and boundary conditions with your team. The study helps compare solutions and identify sensitive areas. Conclusions include the model’s limitations and any additional validation that may be required.

  • 01Load assessment and operating condition review
  • 02Sizing and strength calculations
  • 03Structural finite element simulation
  • 04Deformation, vibration or fatigue studies as required
  • 05Calculation report, interpretation and recommendations
